codexLocal.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Note: Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped AGENTS.md files from the workspace.

fastMode.manualModel: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
fastMode.supported: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
fastMode.unsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Paperclip will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.

engine.label: Execution engine
engine.hint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.

harness.label: Harness
harness.hint: Choose the agent harness that runs your tasks.

dot.connectionHint: A verified event round trip is required before assigning work.
dot.readAttachmentsHint: Let Dot read files attached to its current assigned task. File contents are sent to OpenAI. Does not require workspace command access; off by default.
dot.workspaceHint: Let Dot read and write its assigned workspace and publish files. Requires a local Runner. Commands are available only on Linux with bubblewrap; they cannot read your home directory or use injected credentials.
dot.unmeteredHint: Dot does not report token usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a provider spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.

muse.connectionHint: Pairing, receiver contact, background reply, and agent setup are verified separately.
muse.unmeteredHint: Muse does not report usage or cost. Paperclip cannot enforce a Muse spend ceiling; known company and agent budget limits still apply.

acpx.agentHint: Choose a qualified harness and enter its exact model ID.
acpx.cursorModeHint: Select Cursor's session mode. Permissions and company approval rules still apply.
acpx.unsupportedMode: Unsupported saved mode — select Agent, Plan, or Ask
acpx.piLevelHint: The runner verifies this exact level before each session can prompt. Changing it starts a new session.

managed.profileHint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Remote resource identity is loaded from the stored profile, not this agent config.
managed.spendCeilingHint: Optional per-agent hard ceiling. Leave 1.00 to use a conservative default.
managed.retentionHint: Claude Managed is a stateful beta service and is not eligible for ZDR or HIPAA modes.

agentCore.profileHint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Harness, Memory, IAM, and context-store identity come from the stored profile.
agentCore.ceilingHint: Paperclip estimate; AWS does not provide a per-session currency hard stop.
agentCore.maxIterationsHint: Qualified range is 1–8. Invalid values fail closed to 8.
agentCore.retentionHint: The qualified AgentCore profile retains short-term Memory events for exactly 90 days.

permissionMode.label: Permission mode
permissionMode.hintSuffix: The selected mode does not widen Paperclip's workspace, network, credential, or planning boundaries.
permissionMode.unsupported: Unsupported saved mode — select a qualified mode
permissionMode.codexUnsupportedError: This saved Codex mode cannot start or recover a Paperclip Runner run. Select Automatic (isolated) to remediate it.

lifecycle.label: Runner lifecycle
lifecycle.hint: Turn by turn suspends after each run. Warm keeps the same provider process available between governed runs.

idleTimeout.label: Warm idle timeout (ms)
idleTimeout.hint: After this much inactivity, runnerd checkpoints and suspends the provider session. The maximum is 24 hours.

acpServer.label: ACP server command
acpServer.hint: Optional override for the Codex ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local codex-acp binary.

acpSession.label: ACP session mode
acpSession.hint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.

acpPermissions.label: ACP non-interactive permissions
acpPermissions.hint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.

acpStateDir.label: ACP state directory
acpStateDir.hint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Paperclip-managed organization/agent scoped storage.

acpWarmIdle.label: ACP warm process idle ms
acpWarmIdle.hint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.

secret.storedPlaceholder: Stored secret; enter a new value to replace it

apiBaseUrl.label: API base URL
apiBaseUrl.hint: Hermes API server base URL that Paperclip can reach, such as http://127.0.0.1:8642 or a private HTTPS URL. Default dashboard root/chat URLs such as http://127.0.0.1:9119/chat are accepted and map to /api.

paperclipApiUrl.label: Paperclip API URL
paperclipApiUrl.hint: Optional Paperclip API URL reachable by the Hermes host. This is not a credential.

sessionKeyStrategy.label: Session key strategy
sessionKeyStrategy.hint: Controls X-Hermes-Session-Key. Issue scoped prevents cross-task memory bleed by default.

eventReconnect.label: Event reconnect ms
eventReconnect.hint: Delay before reconnecting the Hermes SSE events stream after a nonterminal disconnect.

insecureHttp.label: Dangerously allow remote HTTP
insecureHttp.hint: Unsafe dev-only escape hatch. Remote Hermes gateways should use HTTPS; loopback HTTP remains allowed.

extraHeaders.label: Extra headers
extraHeaders.hint: Optional JSON object of extra nonsecret headers. Security-critical headers are generated by the adapter.

instructions.label: Instructions
instructions.hint: Optional stable Hermes instructions sent separately from the wake input.

deviceAuth.label: Disable device auth
deviceAuth.info: When enabled, Paperclip persists a device key during onboarding so pairing approvals remain stable across runs.
